entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Massive world-tree and guildhall of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, damaged repeatedly and replanted in a moor after the invasion.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose guildhall is Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave, residing within Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: Entity of the guild who slept in Vitu-Ghazi and told Trostani the tree needed space to lay new roots.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Uprooted Vitu-Ghazi partially during the Decamillennial to drink from Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Sent Rakdos cultists to attack the tree while trying to siphon its power.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who animated Vitu-Ghazi into an enormous elemental in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: God-Eternals
entities.description: Four undead gods who tore the animated tree apart.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God-Eternal who tore out one of the tree's arms.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
entities.description: Statue toppled by the animated Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle on Ravnica in which Vitu-Ghazi was torn apart.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Undead army the animated tree fought.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Original text kept in the library at Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that further damaged the tree.

events.summary: Szadek partially uproots Vitu-Ghazi during the Decamillennial to drink from Mat'Selesnya.
events.quote: uprooted partially by Szadek so he could drink from Mat'Selesnya

events.summary: Sifa Grent sends Rakdos cultists to attack the tree; an axe-wielding demon wounds it.
events.quote: Vitu-Ghazi received a deep wound from an axe-wielding demon

events.summary: Nissa animates Vitu-Ghazi into an elemental that topples the God-Pharaoh's Statue.
events.quote: Vitu-Ghazi was animated by Nissa Revane into an enormous elemental

events.summary: The God-Eternals tear the animated tree apart; Rhonas rips off an arm and Nissa relinquishes control as it collapses.
events.quote: Rhonas tore out one of its arms

events.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a moor within a park on Selesnya territory around a manor-library.
events.quote: The tree was planted around a manor

relations.quote: has served for more than 10,000 years as the focus and guildhall of the guild
aided the troops fighting the Dreadhorde
they gathered around it and tore it apart
